pages.text: A neutron of wavelength λ is split by the first silicon blade, its two paths enclosing an area A, and joined at the third. Tilt the plane of the paths by α and one path climbs higher than the other: gravity changes its momentum, and the phase between them shifts by Δφ = 2πm²gλA·sin α/h². The counts at an exit follow (1 + V·cos Δφ)/2; N neutrons fix the phase to 1/(V√N).
$(thing)Set$(): Tilt α, Neutron wavelength λ, Counting time.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Thermal bending of the crystal: the phase drifts by ±0.05 rad·d.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Gravitational phase Δφ: Δφ = 2πm²gλA·sin α/h²$(br)Fringe: cos Δφ$(br)Phase error: σ = 1/(V√N)
